title: Capacity Forecasting & Autoscale Governance — Q2 Roadmap (Dedicated)
creator: Asha Menon
description: Goal: Define and deliver a repeatable Q2 roadmap for Dedicated capacity autoscaling that ties to OKRs and enforces governance controls to prevent runaway cost or SLA regressions. Scope includes forecasting signals, policy guardrails (cost caps, soft/hard scale limits), an approval flow for emergency capacity hedging, and dashboarding for capacity spend vs. committed reservations. Out of scope for this ticket: new billing model changes or enterprise contractual amendment work.
acceptance_criteria: Forecast model deployed that projects weekly GPU utilization per customer segment with 95% historical accuracy over 30-day windows
Autoscale policy templates (conservative, balanced, aggressive) defined and codified in policy repo with unit tests
Governance workflow implemented: request -> risk scoring -> approval -> enact with audit trail
Console dashboard panel showing reserved vs. actual utilization, forecast, and projected over/undercommit costs
Playbook for capacity emergency hedging with runbook and assigned on-call rotation
milestones: 2026-03-15: Forecast baseline & historical signal analysis complete
2026-04-05: Policy templates prototyped and reviewed with Eng
2026-04-20: Governance workflow MVP (approval + audit) landed in QA
2026-05-10: Console dashboard panels integrated with forecasting API
2026-06-01: External review with SRE and Finance; sign-off on guardrails
2026-06-30: Production rollout of autoscale governance and metrics collection
success_metrics: Reduce dedicated overprovisioning cost by 18% vs. prior quarter
Maintain P95 latency SLO for Dedicated customers during autoscale events
<2 incidents per quarter attributable to autoscale misconfiguration
risks_mitigation: Risk: Forecast model underpredicts spike -> Mitigation: add conservative buffer tier and temp surge pool
Risk: Approval flow slows emergency scaling -> Mitigation: introduce fast-path for high-severity incidents with post-hoc audit
Risk: Console shows inconsistent data -> Mitigation: reconcile lagging telemetry by cross-checking with trace logs and implement alerting for data gaps
updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff meeting with Eng/SRE/Finance. Agreed forecast inputs: historical per-customer qps, model warmup curves, scheduled batch jobs.
2026-03-08: Engineering spike completed (ENG-4210). Found telemetry gaps for burst workloads; added synthetic load generator to exercise autoscale path.

2026-03-10: Decision: Start with three policy templates (conservative/balanced/aggressive). Trade-off: conservative reduces cost efficiency but minimizes SLO risk. Action: Diego to prototype templates by 2026-04-05.
2026-03-12: Finance reviewed initial cost projection; requested guardrail for monthly spend delta > 12% compared to committed reservation budgets.
2026-03-14: Design reviewed dashboard wireframes; feedback: surface projected cost delta and a one-click request-for-hedge flow. Follow-up: Oliver to deliver mockups by 2026-03-22.

2026-03-14: Blocker noted: ENG-4655 (KV cache instrumentation) needed for accurate forecast signals. Assigned to ENG on-call for prioritization. Mitigation: use fallback signal while instrumentation is in progress.
